description: V0.5b recorded-decision replay: the LLM agent's decisions from the live smoke test (docs/benchmark/v05b-dev/llm-decisions.jsonl) submitted again through the protocol by the agent's replay mode, without any model, beside the no-op baseline, under the smoke test's scenario, seed, horizon and cadence. At every decision point the agent rebuilds its memory and prompt from the run and checks them against the recording. Deterministic: a rerun gives the same files. Run from the repository root.
seedPlan: The V0.5b smoke test's seed (docs/benchmark/v05b-dev/config.json), so that the recorded decisions belong to the run.

external.description: the LLM agent (agents/llm/llm_agent.py, llm-agent 2) in replay mode: the live smoke test's recorded decisions, each checked against its decision point and digests, with the memory and prompt rebuilt and checked against their recorded SHA-256; no model is called
